Holland Scholarship — Partial Funding Scholarship in Netherlands (2026) Partial Funding February 1 (most universities) Medium Undergraduate About the Holland Scholarship Funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, alongside Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences, for international students from outside the EEA. This partially funded scholarship is hosted in Netherlands and is available to students from all countries. It supports undergraduate studies in all fields of study. For the latest eligibility criteria, required documents, and application timeline, visit the official Holland Scholarship website . Scholarship Benefits €5,000 one-time grant (first year) Eligibility Nationality Open to students from all countries worldwide Degree Level Undergraduate Fields of Study All fields of study How to Apply 1 Visit the official scholarship website and read the full eligibility criteria and application guidelines. 2 Prepare all required documents: academic transcripts, recommendation letters, personal statement, CV, and language test scores. 3 Complete the online application form with accurate information and upload all supporting documents. 4 Submit your application before the deadline and save confirmation receipts for your records. 5 If shortlisted, prepare for interviews and provide any additional documentation requested. The Holland Scholarship offers partial funding. It covers €5,000 one-time grant (first year). You may need to arrange additional funding for other expenses. Who can apply for the Holland Scholarship? The Holland Scholarship is open to international students from all countries. However, applicants must meet the academic and professional criteria set by the program. Check the official website for detailed eligibility requirements. What is the deadline for the Holland Scholarship? The application deadline for the Holland Scholarship is typically February 1 (most universities). We recommend starting your application at least 2–3 months before the deadline to ensure you have time to gather all required documents and secure recommendation letters. What can I study with the Holland Scholarship? The Holland Scholarship accepts applications across all fields of study. Whether you're interested in engineering, humanities, sciences, or social sciences, you can apply for this scholarship. How competitive is the Holland Scholarship? The Holland Scholarship has a medium level of competitiveness. This program is accessible to well-prepared candidates. Focus on meeting all eligibility criteria and submitting a complete, well-organized application.
